banked_span_trace_share.what: fraction of the activation trace inside G4b's banked top-512 span. e_sink and the control's achieved energy are both measured inside it, so the match is internally consistent; this number says how much of the activation energy that span holds

energy_matched_basis: G4b's banked activation Gram eigenbasis (top 512 per site), NOT the diagonal per-coordinate proxy MN-2 and MN-6 shipped with. G4b's metrics name MN-13 as the consumer of exactly this. e_sink and the control's achieved energy are both measured inside the same truncated span, so the match is internally consistent
